input.charter:
# Charter — T11 Metrics, metering and maturity (retrospective, 2026-11-21)

- **Project:** T11, project id `01a1d039-0d36-782b-8b18-ff07a64dedbe`, track v2, project type `it`, ADM phase G, plateau capability, tranche 1. Unit issues #84 (T11 — Metrics, metering and maturity) and #458 (console: the Metering screen reads the live inference aggregates (T11 built)) are both CLOSED; the measured coverage row is `built` at 8/8 actions, 3/3 modules and 2/2 tables. Issue #84 merged 2026-11-19 (commit `183f5111`, PR #404); #458 landed 2026-11-20 (commit `0a8a6e95`, PR #499).
- **Context:** the project row is closed at the 2026-11-21 snapshot, but it closed with no charter, Statement of Architecture Work, delivery contract, Phase-G review, closure review or published output. This document is the retrospective record written by the 2026-11-21 MSP/TOGAF/SAFe rework under the standing delegation `01a1ff1f-e4ba-72dc-9c1a-13049933cf14`; it does not attest contemporaneous intent.

## Goal

Make the conveyor's own process measurable from its own rows: flow, quality, cost and governance figures computed at read time, spend rolled up at every organisational level, C0–C5 maturity decided by versioned threshold configuration rather than opinion, and the derived cost reconciled with `billing_service` exactly or by an incident.

## Scope

- SPEC_V2 §7.5 — the five metric families, cost derivation, the eight metering levels and the billing reconciliation; §10.4 — the `metrics.*` action family; §12 — the T11 row and its gate.
- `migrations/0059_metrics.sql` — `metric_threshold` (versioned C0–C5 configuration) and `metric_reconciliation` (the billing verdict); no metric table and no stored cost.
- `crates/domain/src/metrics.rs` — the closed evidence vocabulary, the contiguous maturity ladder and the reconciliation rule; `crates/store/src/metrics.rs` — the read models; `crates/actions/src/metrics/mod.rs` — the eight actions; `crates/actions/tests/metrics.rs` and `crates/store/tests/rls_domain.rs` — the proof.
- `seed/catalogue.json` — the `incident` card type; `served-spec.lock.json` — the eight served contracts; `docs/evidence/v2-coverage.*` — the coverage row.
- `docs/design/v2.js` — the live Metering screen reading `measure.inference` from the published snapshot (#458).
- Out of scope: charging (`billing_service` remains the charging system); eval and benchmark-backed quality metrics (S17–S20 own those ledgers); knowledge metrics whose ledgers do not exist (T8); per-tool health and retirement (SPEC_V2 §11.9, the tool platform).

## Deliverables

- Migration `0059_metrics.sql`: `metric_threshold` (one versioned row per tenant and C0–C5 level, `metrics` jsonb, append-only versions, ENABLE and FORCE RLS) and `metric_reconciliation` (`matched | difference | unavailable`, `numeric(18,6)` figures, one row per tenant and period, incident-card FK, shape CHECK).
- The pure rules: nine closed evidence names, the ordered C0–C5 ladder, the no-gap `current_level`, threshold validation and the six-decimal `reconcile` verdict.
- The read models: gate counts, benefits and benefit-at-risk, tranches, run and token totals, usage by all eight levels, the run drill-down, derived cost and the flow family.
- The eight actions `metrics.flow`, `metrics.job`, `metrics.usage`, `metrics.programme`, `metrics.maturity`, `metrics.reconcile`, `metrics.threshold_get` and `metrics.threshold_update`, each one `ActionSpec`.
- The console Metering screen over the snapshot's `measure.inference` totals, by caller and by model, with no fixture fallback (#458).

## Acceptance

The SPEC_V2 §12 gate, verbatim: "every metric and every metering level recomputes from rows; the reconciliation with `billing_service` is exact or opens an incident; a C0–C5 level changes only when the measured evidence crosses its recorded threshold; a gate that never refused is flagged". The executable form is `acceptance/programme/T11.toml`, run by `scripts/verify-project.py` against the published snapshot: the project closes, its scope baseline and charter are approved, the closure outputs are declared and published, a live board-approved delivery contract exists, the Phase-G review cites the published standing delegation, the closure gate is decided by an approver other than its requester, no waiver is expired or self-owned, the tranche-1 PI carries its cadence, plan and objectives, the WBS deliverable carries all four WSJF inputs, every accepted deliverable has a demo credit, and the tranche-1 retro produced at least one lesson.

## Governance

The programme owner decides; the Architecture Board approves the A–D artefacts and the delivery contract; the programme architect (the maintainer sessions under the owner's authority) delivers and evidences the record; `conveyor-approver` decides the gate approvals and `conveyor-e2e` records the acts. The closure gate is decided by an approver other than its requester. Tranche 1 (`01a1e9e0-d787-7f5c-b5ed-15b05f3dc531`) is `authorised` since 2026-11-21T01:11:46Z by the tranche-0 `continue` review `01a1ed84-e111-7082-9fa8-7fe77ccc9024`; its exit criteria are that every project in the tranche (S02, T1, T11) meets acceptance with published evidence and that the end-of-tranche review records continue, pause or stop. This record is retrospective; where the contemporaneous record does not exist it says so rather than reconstructing intent.

The A–D set is approved, the delivery contract is live and board-approved, the Phase-G review cites the published standing delegation, and the closure gate is decided by an approver other than its requester.

input.body:
# Closure review — T11 Metrics, metering and maturity (retrospective, 2026-11-21)

## Outcome vs acceptance

The SPEC_V2 §12 gate has four clauses. Each is met on the committed evidence:

- **Every metric and every metering level recomputes from rows.** `metrics.flow`, `metrics.job`, `metrics.usage`, `metrics.programme` and `metrics.maturity` are read-time aggregates; migration `0059_metrics.sql` adds only `metric_threshold` and `metric_reconciliation`, and `crates/actions/tests/metrics.rs::a_level_moves_only_when_the_evidence_crosses_the_recorded_threshold` shows that the reads write no metric row. `::every_metering_level_sums_to_its_children` proves tenant, department, programme, project, job, run, step and call all sum to the same 3 calls and 3,150 tokens, with an `unattributed` bucket for the `caller_kind='other'` call; `::the_run_drilldown_sums_to_the_call_rows` proves the steps and calls sum to the run.
- **The reconciliation with `billing_service` is exact or opens an incident.** `crates/actions/tests/metrics.rs::reconciliation_is_exact_or_opens_an_incident` matches 0.002 exactly, returns `difference` with delta 0.001 on 0.003 and opens an `incident` card whose meta carries both figures, and records a 503 as `unavailable` with null figures and the upstream error. `crates/domain/src/metrics.rs::reconciliation_is_exact_to_six_decimals` fixes the precision.
- **A C0–C5 level changes only when the measured evidence crosses its recorded threshold.** `::a_level_moves_only_when_the_evidence_crosses_the_recorded_threshold` shows C1 at version 1, a rejection that changes the evidence but keeps the level, a raised threshold version 2 that drops it to C0 with the evidence unchanged, and a lowered version 3 that returns it; a missing metric never lifts a level and `current_level` stops at the first gap.
- **A gate that never refused is flagged.** `::a_gate_with_no_refusal_is_flagged_and_one_refusal_clears_it` puts `tranche_review` (3 approvals, 0 rejections) in `never_refused`, clears it on one rejection, and leaves `benefit_review` untouched.

The accompanying delivery scope is present: the flow family (`::flow_recomputes_and_a_missing_ledger_is_unavailable`: throughput 1, with lead about 3,600 s, cycle 1,800 s, queue 1,800 s, block 540 s and efficiency 0.35, each within the test's tolerance) with missing knowledge ledgers reported as unavailable; the MSP benefit metrics (`::realised_versus_planned_recomputes_and_an_unmeasured_baseline_is_not_zero`, `::a_dependency_slip_names_the_benefits_it_puts_at_risk`); the eight actions at 8/8 coverage, 3/3 modules and 2/2 tables; and the console Metering screen from #458, which reads the snapshot's `measure.inference` (609 calls, 9,458,468 tokens on 2026-11-21T18:50:29Z) and shows no fixture number when the section is absent.

The project closed with four conformance findings: P0 `closed_without_closure_review`, P1 `contract_missing`, P1 `mandatory_artefacts` (all seven A–D artefacts) and P1 `unpublished_declared_output` (closure-review, evidence, project-brief). This rework produces the seven artefacts, the Statement of Architecture Work, the delivery contract, the Phase-G review and all three declared outputs; the findings are closed by this record.

## Evidence

- **Manifest:** `acceptance/programme/T11.toml`, run by `scripts/verify-project.py` against the published snapshot at the re-close; its checks cover the project, baseline, charter, closure outputs, delivery contract, Phase-G review, distinct closure approver, waivers, tranche-1 cadence, PI plan, PI objectives, WSJF inputs, demo credits and lessons.
- **Coverage:** `docs/evidence/v2-coverage.json` — `actions:metrics` `exists`; T11 `built`, 8/8 actions, 3/3 modules, 2/2 tables, gap null.
- **Code and schema:** `migrations/0059_metrics.sql` (two tables, FORCE RLS and the shape CHECK), `crates/domain/src/metrics.rs` (nine evidence names, C0–C5, six-decimal reconcile), `crates/store/src/metrics.rs` (the read models), `crates/actions/src/metrics/mod.rs` (the eight actions), `served-spec.lock.json` (the eight served contracts).
- **Tests:** `crates/actions/tests/metrics.rs` (eight integration tests) and `crates/store/tests/rls_domain.rs::metric_thresholds_are_tenant_isolated`.
- **Console:** `docs/design/v2.js` `meteringLive()`; `docs/design/scripts/check-v2.cjs` 9b–9d; the snapshot `measure.json` generated 2026-11-21T18:50:29Z.
- **Delivery record:** issue #84 merged 2026-11-19 (commit `183f5111`, PR #404); coverage correction `f7062f35` (PR #429); issue #458 merged 2026-11-20 (commit `0a8a6e95`, PR #499).
- **Artefacts:** the seven A–D artefacts produced in this rework, the Statement of Architecture Work, the delivery contract, the charter and this closure review.

## Open items

- **Original governance record: not recoverable.** No charter, Statement of Architecture Work, delivery contract, Phase-G review or closure review was authored before the project closed. This set is retrospective and does not claim contemporaneous intent.

# Project brief — T11 metrics, metering and maturity

## Outcome

Every flow, quality, cost and governance figure the conveyor reports is a read-time computation over its own rows; spend rolls up at eight organisational levels; C0–C5 maturity is decided by versioned threshold configuration; and billing reconciles exactly or opens an incident.

## Boundary

Out of scope: charging — `billing_service` remains the charging system; eval- and benchmark-backed quality metrics (first-pass yield, rework rate, defect escapes, eval score and benchmark delta), whose ledgers belong to S17–S20; knowledge metrics whose ledgers do not exist (T8); and per-tool health and retirement (SPEC_V2 §11.9, the tool platform). The console reads the published snapshot; it never recomputes cost from a stale cache.

## Reuse sources

- `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §7.5 (metrics, metering and the ledger), §10.4 (the `metrics.*` family) and §12 (T11).
- `crates/domain/src/metrics.rs`, `crates/store/src/metrics.rs` and `crates/actions/src/metrics/mod.rs` — the pure rules, the read models and the eight actions.
- `migrations/0059_metrics.sql` — the threshold configuration and the reconciliation record.
- `seed/catalogue.json` — the `incident` card type; `served-spec.lock.json` — the served contracts.
- `docs/design/v2.js` `meteringLive()` and the snapshot's `measure.inference` (#458).

## Inception units

None. T11 is the measurement slice; its inputs are the ledgers and the metric definitions in SPEC_V2 §7.5, not an inception analysis or architecture spike.

## Dependencies

blocked-by: P0 (the programme definition; `meta.depends_on`). related: S02 and T1, the other tranche-1 projects. blocks: T12 (one organisation loop, which follows all V2 slices per SPEC_V2 §12).

## Acceptance

The SPEC_V2 §12 gate, verbatim: "every metric and every metering level recomputes from rows; the reconciliation with `billing_service` is exact or opens an incident; a C0–C5 level changes only when the measured evidence crosses its recorded threshold; a gate that never refused is flagged". It is executed by `acceptance/programme/T11.toml` through `scripts/verify-project.py` against the published snapshot, together with the governance checks listed in the delivery contract.

## Capabilities

The eight `metrics.*` actions, the eight metering levels and the run drill-down, the C0–C5 threshold configuration, the billing reconciliation with an incident on divergence, and the console Metering screen over the snapshot's live inference aggregates.

## Plan

`docs/SPEC_V2.md` §12 (T11). Delivered 2026-11-19 (#84, PR #404); the console unit landed 2026-11-20 (#458, PR #499); reworked and re-closed retrospectively 2026-11-21.

## Risks

- The snapshot's `measure.inference` is the ledger at 2026-11-21T18:50:29Z, not a bounded business period; a windowed figure is the API's job, not the screen's.
- This record asserts the threshold mechanism and its tests, not a live calibrated threshold row; no such row is visible in the 2026-11-21 snapshot.

## Links

- Issues #84 and #458 (both closed); commits `183f5111`, `f7062f35` and `0a8a6e95`.
- `acceptance/programme/T11.toml`, `docs/evidence/v2-coverage.json`, `docs/evidence/rework/T11.json`.

# Evidence — T11 metrics, metering and maturity

## Claim

T11 delivered computed metrics, eight-level metering, C0–C5 maturity from versioned thresholds and an exact-or-incident billing reconciliation; every figure is a read-time aggregate over the conveyor's own rows and no metric or cost is stored. The console Metering screen reads the published snapshot's live inference aggregates and borrows no fixture number.

## Evidence

- **Coverage:** `docs/evidence/v2-coverage.json` records `actions:metrics` as `exists`; the T11 row is `built` with 8/8 actions, 3/3 modules and 2/2 tables, citing `crates/actions/src/metrics`, `crates/domain/src/metrics.rs`, `crates/store/src/metrics.rs` and `migrations/0059_metrics.sql`.
- **Delivery:** issue #84 merged 2026-11-19 (commit `183f5111`, PR #404): migration `0059_metrics.sql`, the pure rules, the read models, the eight actions and the integration tests. The coverage correction followed in commit `f7062f35` (PR #429). Issue #458 merged 2026-11-20 (commit `0a8a6e95`, PR #499): `meteringLive()` renders `measure.inference`.
- **Schema:** `metric_threshold` holds one versioned row per tenant and C0–C5 level; `metric_reconciliation` holds `matched | difference | unavailable` with `numeric(18,6)` figures, a shape CHECK and an incident-card FK. Both tables enable and force RLS. No metric table exists.
- **Proof:** `crates/actions/tests/metrics.rs` has eight integration tests — every metering level sums to its children (tenant 3 calls / 3,150 tokens and every level equal, with an `unattributed` bucket); the run drill-down sums to 4,500 tokens; flow recomputes (throughput 1; lead about 3,600 s, cycle 1,800 s, queue 1,800 s, block 540 s and efficiency 0.35, each within the test's tolerance) and a missing ledger is unavailable; the C0–C5 ladder moves only across recorded threshold versions 1→2→3; a never-refused gate is flagged and one rejection clears it; benefits recompute and an unmeasured baseline is not zero; a dependency slip names the benefits at risk; reconciliation matches 0.002 exactly, opens an incident on the 0.003 difference and records 503 as unavailable.
- **Tenant isolation:** `crates/store/tests/rls_domain.rs::metric_thresholds_are_tenant_isolated` proves tenant A sees only its own threshold and a forged write under A's scope fails WITH CHECK.
- **Live aggregates:** the published snapshot's `measure.json` (generated 2026-11-21T18:50:29Z) reports 609 calls, 9,458,468 tokens (9,374,195 prompt and 84,273 completion), 606 cache misses, 0 hits, 3 unknown cache classes and 0 non-ok calls; by caller, agent_run 604 calls / 9,457,017 tokens and other 5 / 1,451; by model, claude-sonnet-5-5 81 calls / 970,518 tokens, image_gen 3 / 0 and local-llm 525 / 8,487,950. Its note fixes cost as a read-time derivation, not a stored figure.

## Verification

- `cargo test -p conveyor-actions --test metrics` — the eight integration tests listed above.
- `cargo test -p conveyor-store --test rls_domain metric_thresholds_are_tenant_isolated` — tenant isolation of the threshold configuration.
- `python3 scripts/verify-project.py --project T11 --snapshot <published-snapshot>/data` — the manifest, including its governance checks.
- `node docs/design/scripts/check-v2.cjs` — the console checks 9b–9d for the live Metering screen.
- Read `migrations/0059_metrics.sql`, `crates/domain/src/metrics.rs`, `crates/store/src/metrics.rs` and `crates/actions/src/metrics/mod.rs` for the absence of a stored metric.

## Links

- `docs/SPEC_V2.md` §7.5, §10.4 and §12; `acceptance/programme/T11.toml`; `docs/evidence/v2-coverage.json`; `served-spec.lock.json`.
- Issues #84 and #458; commits `183f5111`, `f7062f35` and `0a8a6e95`.
- `crates/actions/tests/metrics.rs`, `crates/store/tests/rls_domain.rs`, `migrations/0059_metrics.sql`.
- `docs/design/v2.js` `meteringLive()`; the snapshot `measure.json`.

## Gap

- **Governance record:** the original charter, Statement of Architecture Work, delivery contract, Phase-G review and closure review were never authored; the contemporaneous record is the merged code, the coverage row and the git history. This set is retrospective.
- **Outputs:** the project closed with `project-brief`, `evidence` and `closure-review` unpublished; this rework publishes them.
- **Manifest:** the green `acceptance/programme/T11.toml` run is the rework's closing gate; no earlier green run is claimed here.
- **Quality family:** eval- and benchmark-backed metrics (first-pass yield, rework rate, defect escapes, eval score, benchmark delta) remain S17–S20; T11's implemented quality evidence is approval- and run-derived.
- **Knowledge metrics:** pack hit rate and lesson promotion rate are `unavailable` until their ledgers exist (T8); they are not zero and not claimed.
- **Threshold values:** no live tenant C0–C5 threshold row is asserted by this record; the mechanism, the closed vocabulary and their tests are what is evidenced.
- **Measurement window:** the snapshot aggregates are the whole ledger at 2026-11-21T18:50:29Z, not a bounded period; the window is an API parameter.
